description:
Configuration operations available via the c64_config tool.

Operations:
- list: List configuration categories reported by the firmware. Required inputs: none.
- get: Read a configuration category or specific item. Required inputs: category.
- set: Write a configuration value in the selected category. Required inputs: category, item, value.
- batch_update: Apply multiple configuration updates in a single request. Required inputs: none.
- load_flash: Load configuration from flash storage. Required inputs: none.
- save_flash: Persist the current configuration to flash storage. Required inputs: none.
- reset_defaults: Reset firmware configuration to factory defaults. Required inputs: none.
- read_debugreg: Read the Ultimate debug register ($D7FF). Required inputs: none.
- write_debugreg: Write a hex value to the Ultimate debug register ($D7FF). Required inputs: value.
- info: Retrieve Ultimate hardware information and status. Required inputs: none.
- version: Fetch firmware version details. Required inputs: none.
- snapshot: Snapshot configuration to disk for later restore or diff. Required inputs: path.
- restore: Restore configuration from a snapshot file. Required inputs: path.
- diff: Compare the current configuration with a snapshot. Required inputs: path.
- shuffle: Discover PRG/CRT files and run each with optional screen capture. Required inputs: none.
